summary: Independently verified the Pool Wallet NEGATIVE balance production fix end-to-end. All 12 pytest cases PASS (backend 100%). Confirmed: (A) pool=10.000001 / 4 members → per_member=2.5, distributed=10.0, remainder=9.99e-7 (no over-distribution, never negative); (B) negative balance (-500) is auto-healed to 0 by distribute_pool_to_core_team without distributing anything; (C) 3 concurrent POST /api/pool-wallet/admin/distribute via asyncio.gather + httpx.AsyncClient → exactly 1 success + 2 skipped ('Already running') validating the asyncio lock; (D) POST /api/pool-wallet/admin/heal-negative-balance correctly returns {success:true, healed:true, previous_balance:-250.5, new_balance:0.0} when negative and {success:true, healed:false, message:'Balance is non-negative, no healing needed'} when already >=0; (E) 8 back-to-back distribution cycles on 7.777777 pool never go negative; (F) Regression: pool=40 / 4 → each member's prc_balance credited by exactly 10.0, transactions.core_team_bonus with description='Core Team Bonus - Pool Distribution' inserted, pool_wallet_transactions distribution doc has correct members_count/per_member/balance_after. (G) Regression: /api/pool-wallet/info, /api/pool-wallet/admin/balance, /api/user/{uid}, /api/user/{uid}/dashboard, /api/community/posts all return 200. Pool wallet original document was snapshotted at module start and restored at teardown; all test-pool-215- users, core_team_members, transactions, and pool_wallet_transactions are cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/pool_wallet.py _distribute_pool_to_core_team_inner uses math.floor(raw_share * 1_000_000)/1_000_000 which mathematically guarantees per_member*N <= pool_balance - verified with 10.000001/4 test producing remainder 1e-6 (never negative).
Defensive clamp at line 228-231 (if total_distributed > pool_balance recompute) is dead code with floor but acts as a safety net - acceptable.
Atomic conditional $inc on line 234 with {'balance': {'$gte': total_distributed}} is correct - if race occurs, modified_count==0 and function aborts without crediting users.

Concurrency guard uses a module-level asyncio.Lock initialized lazily on first call. Since FastAPI runs one event loop per worker, this is correct. NOTE: If the backend is ever scaled to multiple Uvicorn workers / multiple pods, the in-process lock will not prevent cross-process double-distribution - would need a MongoDB findAndModify-based distributed lock or Redis lock. Recommend documenting this in code comment or adding a DB-level sentinel for multi-worker safety.

Heal endpoint /admin/heal-negative-balance has no admin auth guard - same as /admin/distribute and /admin/members (pre-existing pattern in this router). Consider adding admin auth dependency across the whole /admin subroute once across the codebase.

balance_after in transactions.core_team_bonus is hardcoded to 0 (line 263) - this means PRC statement will not show user's running balance for core_team_bonus rows. Minor display issue (pre-existing, not part of this fix).

rca_of_the_issue: Original production bug (pool_wallet.balance = -3,682.89 PRC) had 3 independent root causes all now fixed in routes/pool_wallet.py: (1) round() in per_member calculation could round the share UP so N*per_member > pool_balance (e.g. round(3.333333667,6)=3.333334 → 3*3.333334=10.000002 > 10.000001); FIX: math.floor(raw_share*1e6)/1e6 mathematically caps N*per_member <= pool_balance. (2) Startup catch-up cron could fire concurrently with the scheduled cron, both reading the same positive balance and both $inc -balance, doubly deducting; FIX: module-level asyncio.Lock wraps _distribute_pool_to_core_team_inner; second caller sees locked() and returns {skipped:true}. (3) No floor on balance after $inc meant once negative, it stayed negative; FIX: pre-check heals neg→0 before distributing AND atomic $inc is conditional on {balance:{$gte:total_distributed}} so even a pre-existing negative can never be made more negative. New /admin/heal-negative-balance is a one-shot operator tool to fix historical corruption and logs a balance_heal pool_wallet_transactions row for audit.
